extension.description:
Watch your favourite sports live with beIN Sports Connect (APAC).
Subscription required.
This is a private fork (github.com/Purple-Drain/plugin.video.beinsports.apac) restoring Catch Up/VOD browsing, which upstream removed between 0.4.1 and 0.5.2, and grouping each fixture's full match and highlights into one folder. Not affiliated with SlyGuy or beIN Media Group.
extension.news: 0.5.2+pd.1: Catch Up/VOD browsing restored (grouped by fixture: full match + extended + short highlights), Upcoming Live and Recently Live folders, a menu_dump route for kodi-strm-pipeline's Football hub.
